data_fields.name: lunge_distance
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.9 out over 200 ms, back over 160 ms

data_fields.name: kill_xp_per_level
data_fields.donor_constant: kill_experience * level; level 0 gives kill_experience / 2 (kill_experience value not read)

best_idea: The finisher clip is chosen from the engine's own kill result, starts before the strike on one shared clock, the HP bar counts down over it, and the real HP is committed only after the clip.
decision_why: Keep the outcome-keyed clip and the countdown-then-commit order (the engine decides, the client shows it). Adapt: take the kill flag from the server result, not the displayed damage, and seed the tie-break from the fight record. Donor has no blood or gore, so the blood look is ours.
acceptance: A killing blow plays the kill clip only when the server's fight result says dies=true; the defender's HP bar counts down over the clip and ends on the server's final HP; replaying the same fight record picks the same clip.
